tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i thab gter gyi man ngag ro bcud nus mthu'i snying po bzhugs so// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ srid pa'i dpal 'byor ma lus rgyas pa'i phyir/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi byin rlabs las/ /legs 'khrungs lha chen ga na pa ti la/ /btud de gong gi thab gter man ngag 'dri/ /de la 'dir lha chen tshogs bdag gi man ngag rnams las rgyas pa'i las gtso bor gyur pa thab gter gyi man ngag ni/ bla chen chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i tshogs bdag sgrub yig chen mo'i gsham nas 'di ltar gsungs te/ thab gter gyi sgo nas dngos grub myur du nod par bya ba ni/ rdzas la rin po che dang / 'bru sna dang / dri bzang po btab ste/ 'dam spag byas te ras kyi khar brdzi bcag byas te maṇḍal khru gang pa gcig bya/ de la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa gcig bri ste/ lte ba la oṃ mu khyud la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor/ rtsibs brgyad la gaḥbargyad bri/ mu khyud la gzungs sngags gnyis po gang rung bri/ de'i phyi rim gyi mu khyud la rten 'brel snying po bri/ de so btang thab gru bzhi pa byas te 'khor lo shong bar brus nas de'i nang du ba'i rnam lngas legs par byug go /de skam pa dang dri bzang gis byug de skam pa dang rdza'i 'khor lo bris la spos byug te yi ge steng du bstan la gzhug de'i steng du g.yam pas bkag ste/ de'i steng du'ang zhal la legs pas byas te/ dri bzang pos byugs/ de'i thog tu phrin las gang byed kyi shing gis thab brtsigs te/ thab kyi dbyibs kyang phrin las la sbyor ro/ /de nas sbyor ba dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum ste/ nub dang po sbyor ba'i dus su dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul/ dge 'dun la chos ston drangs/ 'byung po la gtor ma sbyin/ chos skyong la gtor ma chen po bsngos la/ bdag 'di lta bu'i sgrub pa byed pas bgegs kyi bar chad mi 'byung bar gsol ba gdab/

tshogs bdag gi gtor ma chen po gtar bzung la las ma tshar ba mi btang ngo / /dngos gzhi'i dus du thab kyi rtsa na phar mchod pa lnga tshar bsham/ bsreg rdzas ni/ rtsi mar la du'i ril bu bdun tshar gnyis dang ril bu nyer gcig bsags te/ 'bras dang / gro dang / nas dang / til dang / so ba dang / dkar gsum dang mngar gsum bsags/ bar der rang nyid skyabs 'gro sems bskyed de/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa'i ngang las/ rang lha'i bskyed rim tshar ba'i rjes la/ thab bhrūṃ las gzhal yas khang du bsam/ raṃ las ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i nang du thab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i oṃ dang gaḥbargyad yod pa las/ padma dang zla ba'i steng du tshogs bdag dgu bskyed/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros te/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sum cu rtsa gsum nas spyan drangs la mdun gyi de la bstim la/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas dkon mchog dang ga na pa ti la mchod pa lnga dbul/ bdun rnam dag bya/ de nas thab tu me sbar la/ me'i gzi brjid bskyed pa'i phyir mar dgang blug gsum dbul/ de nas me'i nang nas ga na pa ti gzi brjid dang ldan par bzhugs par bsam/ nas la sogs pa'i 'bru dang / dur wa dang / mchod pa'i rdzas rnams so so'i sngags kyis dbul/ de nas la du'i ril bu re re la sgrub sngags bdun bzlas shing me'i nang du tshogs bdag bskyed de phul bas mnyes par bsam zhing / ril bu bdun tshar gcig bsreg go /de nas yang mchod rdzas rnams tshar gcig dbul/ rtsa ba'i sngags gsum po la wa shaṃ ku ru dang / puṣṭiṃ ku ru dang / shantiṃ ku ru dang / las gang byed rnams btags la bya'o/ /drag po la ni mā ra ya dzwa la raṃ btags so/ /me shi ba dang / ril bu nyi shu rtsa gcig po re re la las sngags btags la brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing / thab kyi me 'dag gi steng du spungs so/ /me lha mnyes par bsam/

gtor ma btang / bzod gsol bya/ las sngags spel tshig dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab/ me lha mi gshegs par thab kyi 'khor lo la bstim/ de lta bu'i bya ba rdzogs pa'i mthar thug pa byas te/ de nas thab kyi thog tu g.yam pas dgab/ dri bzang gi 'dag pas g.yogs la/ de'i thab btsugs te zas sna tshogs tshad g.yos la dge 'dun la drangs/ bkra shis kyi tshigs gsum bcad pa brjod/ thab tu ci g.yos pa'i phud kyis tshogs bdag la phul zhing mnyes pas zas nor gyi char 'bebs par bsam mo/ /de ltar spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa de la nor gyi char 'bebs par 'gyur te/ rnam thos kyi bu bzhin no/ /yang na thab kyi 'og ma yin pa'i sa phyogs su byed na/ 'khor lo dang lha bskyed pa dang / bsreg rdzas dbul ba yan chad gong dang 'dra'o/ /bsreg rdzas zin pa dang dong kha bcad nas de'i steng du khang bu gru bzhi pa gnyis bya/ de'i nang du ba'i rnam lnga dang dri bzang po byugs/ de'i nang du tshogs bdag gi sku rab gnas dang ldan pa bzhugs su bcug la/ de'i khar la du dang / la phug dang sbyar ba'i gtor ma bshams nas mchod pa sna tshogs pas mchod na dngos grub ci 'dod pa char bzhin du 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /thab gter gyi sbyin bsreg go /zhes gsungs pas de'i gsal byed cung zad 'dri na/ thab gter gyi 'khor lo 'di man ngag rnams las tshar gnyis bris nas/ gcig thab kyi gdan dang / gcig thab yol la 'jug par gsungs/ lte ba'i oṃ gyi mthar nang nas phyir sbrul 'khyil ba ltar mdun nas g.yas bskor du bza' btung 'byor pa rgyas pa'i spel tshig 'dri/ rtsibs kyi phyi'i mu khyud la tshogs bdag snying po'i gzungs 'dri/ yi ge thams cad mgo phyir bstan bskor yin/ dngos gzhi la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba'i skabs su rten khyad par can la mchod 'bul/ dge 'dun kyi sde la mang 'gyed sogs bsnyen bkur/ sil gtor dang cha gsum sogs sri zhu'i mgron la gtor ma/

gur zhal sogs chos skyong la bskang phrin/ nged rang nas bsgrigs pa'i tshogs bdag mchod chog yid 'phrog dbang rgyal sogs nas 'byung ba bzhin tshogs bdag la mchod gtor rgyas par phul la thab gter gyi las ma grub bar rten gtor ltar bzung ngo / /dngos gzhi la gang du thab kha 'cha' ba'i sa der thab 'khor gzhug tshul gong du bshad pa'i 'phags pa rin po che'i gsung de bzhin dang / 'khor lo gcig rgyab yol gyi tshul du bslangs/ gnyis ka'i phyi nas g.yam bkag dang 'jim zhal byas la bskams pa'i khar rgyas pa'i thab ser po gru bzhi rgyar khru do/ kha khyer mu ran gnyis ka la sor brgyad re yod pa'i mu ran la rin po che'i phreng ba dang / lte bar padma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su rdo rje ser po/ thab kyi phyir stegs bu gru bzhi pa dpangs tshad dang bcas pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje bris pa'i kha khyer steng nas 'bras bu can gyi shing gis bskyed pa'i cha las byung ba'i shing ngam/ srog chags med pa'i lci bas gru bzhi khru gang gi tshad du brtsigs/ thab kyi g.yas su zlum gtor ser po zho mar las sbrus pa gtor gdug can dang chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod ser po/ thab kyi g.yon nas phar/ yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / /so ba 'bras nas gro dang ni/ /sran ma dur ba ku sha rnams/ /lag len ji bzhin legs par bshams/ /zhes pa ltar gyi thun mong gi rdzas thams cad kha sgyur ser pos byas pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzas rin po che sna tshogs shing thog sna tshogs/ nor phyug kyi spu sna tshogs/ man ngag nas 'byung ba'i la du'i ril bu nyi shu rtsa brgyad snod so sor bsham pa'am/ yang na gcig tu spungs pa rnams bshams/ 'jig rten pa'i lhor stan ser po bzang zhing mtho ba'i drung me yol gangs ri waṃ dang chu ris can gyi rgyab stegs kyi khar rdor dril nang mchod 'thor nas/ rdor dril gyi bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar/

shing rigs la ras dmar dkris pa'i spor lde rnams bsham/ rang nyid rgyan gos ser po byas la/ stan la khyel 'dug gi g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum bzang po'i 'dug stangs sam yang na skyil krung las g.yas cung zad brkyang ba'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug la/ mchod rdzas rnams la nang mchod gtor/ sumbha nis bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badzra shapta'i bar/ gaṇḍe ra ṇi sogs rol mo dang bcas/ yid 'phrog dbang rgyal sogs nas 'byung ba ltar gyi 'byung 'dul gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa byas la/ rdo rje'i rtses thab la nang mchod 'thor tshul dang suṃ bha nis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po gru bzhi rgyar khru do/ zabs su khru gang / mu ran la rin po che'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/ bud shing rtsigs pa dang bcas par gyur/ de'i stegs bu'i thab kyi nang du ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i dbus su/ bhrūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtsig pa nang nas rim pa bzhin ser/ dkar sngo dmar ljang dang ldan pa/ nang gi phyogs mdog shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus ser ba'i dbus su 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte ba dang /

rtsibs brgyad la pad zla'i gdan re re dbus su oṃ dang rtsibs brgyad la gaḥbargyad yongs su gyur pa las yid 'phrog dbang rgyal sogs nas 'byung ba ltar tshogs bdag dgu bskyed/ 'on kyang sku mdog dmar ba las ser mdangs can 'od zer ser po rab tu 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs par bskyed/ rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas zhes sogs dang / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshegs bgegs rgyal tshogs kyi bdag /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ /oṃ gaḥgaḥsiddhi siddhi sarba artha me pra sa dha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswāhā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ zhes padma'i gdan phul/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ slar yang rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma/ yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad thab kyi steng mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ mchod pa byin rlabs gong bzhin byas la/ oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa ga na pa ti sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar la rigs 'gre shes par bya/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs yan lag bdun pa lan gsum/ gong du bshad pa'i spor lde la dge 'dun gyi g.yos khang nas byung ba'am/ rgyal po'i pho brang nas byung ba'am/ me shel gyi 'od sogs las byung ba'i me sbar la thal mo'i bar du bzung nas/

oṃ āḥgaḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes dang / thab la gru bzhir g.yas bskor lan gsum bskor/ oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ zhes pas thab nang du me sbar/ dgang blugs mar bcas kha sbyar khu tshur las mtheb mdzub kyi rtse sprad pa'i tshigs bar ma bcags pa rin po che khu tshur gyis bzung la dzwa la'i sngags dang bcas thab la g.yas skor gru bzhir phul bas me kha gsos la me shin tu 'bar ba dang byon zan 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥgaḥhūm̐ swāhā/ bdun gyi mar dgang blugs bdun phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ ga na pa ti agne ye ā di bya ā di bya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ye ga na pa ti sa pa ri wā ra sye sarba shrī bhu ti puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes brjod la g.yas bskor gru bzhir bskor/ slar yang de 'dra ba tshar gnyis byas la/ oṃ ga na pa ti arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar la rigs 'gre sbyar/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs sogs bstod pa byas la/ yam shing nas bzung bsreg rdzas rnams brgya dang brgyad 'bul ba'i tshang ma'i sngags ni/ oṃ ga na pa ti ma ma rakṣañtsa shāntiṃ ku ru sarba shrī bhu ti puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes pa kho nas 'bul/ 'bul rim ni bsham gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar las/ dur ba'i rjes su rin po che/ shing thog nor phyugs kyi spu rnams dang / ku sha bcas phul la grangs ni brgya rtsa brgyad dam bdun gyi bar ci 'grub bo/ /de nas gong du snod bdun du la du'i ril bu re re bshams pa las ril bu gcig snod bcas bzung nas oṃ āḥgaḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum bzlas pa'i mthar gong gi 'bul sngags de bzlas te thab tu dbul/ de bzhin du lhag ma drug la'ang re re nas bsnyen sngags bdun dang / 'bul sngags tshar re bzlas la phul nas me nang gi tshogs bdag mnyes par bsam/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs 'bul tshul bcas yid 'phrog dbang rgyal sogs nas 'byung ba ltar la rgyas par na nang mchod 'bul skabs su tshogs bdag gi bla brgyud brjod pa sogs rgyas pa'i lugs dang /

bstod pa'ang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa sogs rgyas pa bya/ de nas me lce zhi bud shing sogs bsregs pa'i me rdog dmar prog ge ba de la la du nyi shu rtsa gcig 'bul ba ni/ gong du snod nyer gcig tu bshams pa re re nas blangs/ snod gcig tu spungs na rim bzhin snod gcig tu bzung la oṃ āḥgaḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i mthar gong gi 'bul sngags brjod de thab me rdog gis gang ba der phul/ de bzhin du la du lhag ma nyi shu'ang snod du rim bzhin bzung nas bsnyen sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dang 'bul sngags tshar res phul bas mnyes par bsam/ gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs/ gu gul sogs kyis bdug byin rlabs bde mchog sogs nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ yid 'phrog dbang rgyal sogs nas rgyun gtor 'bul skabs su bshad par ltar phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la thab 'khor la bris pa'i 'dod gsol de brjod/ he ru ka'i yig brgya ci nus bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs tshigs bcad lhug gis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ āḥgaḥhūm̐ ma ma shrī bhu ti sarba puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar rgyas pa'i thab me lha dang bcas pa 'od zer ser po'i rnam par zhu nas thab kyi 'khor lo la thim pas dpal tshogs kyi bdag po thab la brtan par bzhugs nas bza' btung 'byor pa thams cad rgyas pa'i las mdzad par gyur/ zhes brjod la rang gi gnas gsum bsrung / dge ba bsngo/ bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /de nas sbyin sreg gi yo byad rnams bsdus/ thab kyi me de ma shi'i bar 'gul bskyod mi bya/ gal te glo bur du bsdu dgos shor tshe phal cher yal ba dang 'o ma chu dri bzang rnams lhan cig tu sbyar bas me la sbran nas thal ba bsdus/ rgyas pa'i thab de'i khar bla brang ngam/ rgyal khab chen po'i thab dang / dge 'dun mang po la zhabs tog zhu ba'i thab ji ltar 'os pa brtsigs/

sngar gyi thal ba de thab la g.yogs pa'i 'jim pa dang bsres nas phyir mi 'khyar ba bya/ thab yongs rdzogs grub nas las bskul ba'i tshe/ thog mar thab de la 'bru'i char pa phab bkra shis tshig gang shes brjod/ de nas me btang la g.yos rnams legs par byas te/ ji srid bskal pa'i bar bza' btung bkol ba'i phud de/ oṃ āḥgaḥhūm̐ swāhā/ zhes brjod la thab nang gi me la rgyun du phul nas dkon mchog mchod pa dang / lus zung rgyas shing dge ba'i bya ba sgrub pa'i lus brtas par byas pas 'byor pa rgyas pa'i phan yon sogs ni gong du 'phags pa rin po ches gsungs pa ltar ro/ /thab kyi 'og ma yin pa'i sa phyogs su byed tshul kyang 'phags pa rin po che gsung ltar ro/ /zhes dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i thab 'khor sbyin sreg dang bcas pa 'di yang dpal sa skya'i chos grwa rnam gnyis kyi rung khang dpal 'byor rgya mtshor nyams len gso bgyis skabs sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po bla chen chos kyi rgyal po 'phags rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i tshogs bdag sgrub yig chen mo'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg dang thab gter gyi sgo nas dngos grub bod par bya ba nyin tshad mar bzung zhing / gsal byed rnams tshad thub kyi yig cha gzhan nas kha bskangs te/ thog mar dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog pho brang gi yang steng g.yab ring nyi 'od 'khyil bar dbu tshugs kha'u sman chab kyi spro gur 'dzam gling yid smon du sbyar ba dge/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i thab gter gyi man ngag/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
